title: mdd-booster configuration (mdd.json)
description: Config consumed by `mdd build` — one or more M3L sources, generated into one or more targets (Sql/Model/Api/TypeScript). A property placed at the wrong level (e.g. a target-level knob left at the root) is otherwise silently ignored by the loader; this schema's additionalProperties:false at every level exists specifically to catch that.

$schema.description: Optional — point editors at this file for autocomplete/validation.

sources.description: Paths to .m3l.md files, relative to this file's directory. Multiple sources are parsed as one merged resolve unit (cross-file inheritance/interfaces are supported).

targets.description: One or more generation targets. The same type may appear more than once (e.g. two Api targets for two servers sharing one model) as long as their path differs.

projectPath.description: Output directory, relative to this file's directory unless absolute.

dialect.description: SQL dialect. tsql (default) keeps the SSDT/T-SQL layout; postgres/postgresql/pg switches to snake_case identifiers and a tables_gen/ layout. Matched case-insensitively by the CLI; use lowercase here.

schema.description: Database schema name. Defaults to "dbo" for tsql, "public" for postgres.

emitSqlProj.description: tsql only — patch the .sqlproj ItemGroup with generated files. Set false when a desired-state tool (e.g. Schemorph) consumes the schema instead. Not supported under dialect:postgres (that dialect has no .sqlproj concept).

emitRefreshScript.description: tsql only — emit the post-deployment RefreshViews.sql (sp_refreshview). Independent of emitSqlProj. Not supported under dialect:postgres.

emitEnumCheckConstraints.description: Emit table-level CK_{Table}_{Column} CHECK constraints for enum columns. Off by default because SSDT dacpac represents CHECK as drop+create on every diff; declarative-tool consumers (Schemorph) can opt in for DB-level enum enforcement.

emitForeignKeyIndexes.description: Create an index on every @reference foreign-key column the model has not already covered by a PK/unique/composite-index leading column. Default true since 0.13.0 (was false before) — set false to keep pre-0.13 output.

projectPath.description: Output directory, relative to this file's directory unless absolute.

dbContextName.description: Name of the generated DbContext class.

sqlProjectPath.description: Optional path to the SSDT SQL project root. When set, the generator scans dbo/Views/ for {Name}ExtView.sql files to use as the highest-priority read backing.

dialect.description: Must match the Sql target's dialect this model is paired with — a mismatch produces snake_case/PascalCase-mismatched naming between the DDL and the EF mapping (build-time warning, not an error).

projectPath.description: Output directory, relative to this file's directory unless absolute.

namespace.description: C# namespace for the generated ApiRegistration_gen.cs.

entitiesNamespace.description: Namespace of the entity types this target references. Required (build error) when more than one Model target declares a namespace; otherwise inferred from the sole Model target.

includeEntities.description: Whitelist of entities this target exposes. Mutually exclusive with excludeEntities (build error if both are set). Omit both for all entities. Does not track new entities added later — prefer excludeEntities if new entities should be exposed by default.

excludeEntities.description: Blacklist of entities this target omits. Mutually exclusive with includeEntities.

outputPath.description: Directory the generated *_gen.ts files (5) go into, relative to this file's directory unless absolute.

formsOutputPath.description: Directory {Entity}Form_gen.tsx files go into. Omit to skip form generation entirely.

formLayoutImport.description: Module a generated form imports FormSection/FormRow from. The default is a historical compatibility value, not a recommendation.

formControlsImport.description: Module a generated form imports its controls (UInput/UTextarea/USelect/UCheckbox) from.

formSelectOptionsImport.description: Module supplying enumToOptions, consumed by the generated {Enum}Labels maps.

includeEntities.description: Whitelist of entities this target exposes. Mutually exclusive with excludeEntities. Keep aligned with any Api target's filter — entity_names_gen.ts mirrors OData entity set names, and a name this target advertises without a matching Api target registering it becomes a dead OData URL (build-time warning).

excludeEntities.description: Blacklist of entities this target omits. Mutually exclusive with includeEntities.
